title: Certified Inference and Training for Deep Equilibrium Networks: A Continuation Framework with Polynomial Complexity Guarantees
summary: The method replaces standard fixed-point iteration and implicit-differentiation training of deep equilibrium networks with a certified homotopy-continuation tracker plus an interpolation-based trainer using dormant bilinear rank-one channels. It costs implementation complexity far beyond standard DEQ code: certified gate realization, column stability checks, loaded Tikhonov solves, and precision budgets, none of which are supported by existing frameworks. The guarantees hold only on a certified promise class; on real instances outside that class the certified passes can fail, requiring residual-aligned repair, and no measured latency or quality benefit exists.
rationale: This is a theoretical complexity and formal-verification result whose certified promise class, heavy precondition machinery, and absence of demonstrated practical speed or quality gains make it unsuitable for production adoption on constrained infrastructure today.
technique: Certified continuation framework for DEQ inference and training
